note-Main.text:
Shows: the app front door. New-session hero with prompt, project, agent and model pickers; recent sessions; projects.
Try: Shared Tweaks: accent (seed colour), dark, density (comfortable or compact), motion (off stills everything). items (0 to 6) changes the recent-session list; 0 gives the empty list card. Hover rows and tiles; focus the prompt.
Stands for: the home route in packages/app (home/, new-session/). The search bar opens the palette board.
Motion: drifting tonal shapes behind the hero (dramatic); staggered rise on panels; shape-morph on hover and press.
Unbuilt, unverified: this layout is a proposal. Session rows, status chips and the project list use sample data. Nothing here is wired to the server.

note-Session.text:
Shows: one session. Timeline with tool calls, a permission request, composer, and a side panel with tabs, changed files and a diff.
Try: Shared Tweaks: accent (seed colour), dark, density (comfortable or compact), motion (off stills everything). stage: permission, streaming, idle. items (0 to 6) changes the file list. The agent and diff-layout segmented buttons respond.
Stands for: session/ in packages/app. The permission card uses the real replies (once, always, reject) and the real permissions key.
Motion: permission card pulses until answered (dramatic); flowing progress and blinking caret while streaming; rise on entry.
Unbuilt, unverified: side-panel tabs other than Changes are not drawn. The diff and transcript are sample content. The context meter is a placeholder figure.

note-Palette.text:
Shows: the palette over a dimmed home screen. Settings results carry live controls (segmented, switch, slider) beside commands, sessions and files.
Try: Shared Tweaks: accent (seed colour), dark, density (comfortable or compact), motion (off stills everything). stage: results, no-results, regex-error. items (0 to 6) changes the command list. Drag the slider, flip the switch, pick an update mode.
Stands for: home/start/command-palette.tsx plus the settings search index. Editing a setting inside search results is new.
Motion: scrim fade and spring-in of the dialog; error pulse on the regex-error banner.
Unbuilt, unverified: inline setting controls in the palette, the regex toggle and the Ctrl+Shift+F binding are proposals. No global key handler exists on the board.

note-ShellStages.text:
Shows: the four whole-screen stages of the app shell.
Try: Shared Tweaks: accent (seed colour), dark, density (comfortable or compact), motion (off stills everything). stage: loading, empty, offline, error.
Stands for: session/route-error.tsx, server-unavailable-panel.tsx and the first-run empty home.
Motion: shimmer skeleton and flowing connect bar (loading); slow shape drift (empty); flowing retry bar (offline); alarm pulse on the error icon (dramatic).
Unbuilt, unverified: copy and layout are proposals. The stack trace is sample text with a placeholder session id. Auto-retry timing is not specified.

note-ConfigOverview.text:
Shows: the entry to settings. Twelve categories with their real config keys, the search field with regex toggle, and the source-layer legend (Default, Global, Project).
Try: Shared Tweaks: accent (seed colour), dark, density (comfortable or compact), motion (off stills everything). stage: browse, search (regex on, matching keys listed). items (0 to 6) changes the result count. Scope segmented responds.
Stands for: packages/app/src/settings (search-catalog.ts, search-index.ts) over packages/schema/src/config.ts.
Motion: staggered rise of category tiles; tile shape-morph on hover.
Unbuilt, unverified: the category grouping, the per-category counts and regex search are proposals; counts are sample data.

note-ConfigGeneral.text:
Shows: top-level keys with rich controls: shell, model (+ variant), default_agent, username, timezone, update, share, enterprise.url, snapshots, automations, worktree.directory.
Try: Shared Tweaks: accent (seed colour), dark, density (comfortable or compact), motion (off stills everything). Click segmented options and switches; hover or focus an info button for the schema description; every row has a source badge and a reset.
Stands for: Config.Info in packages/schema/src/config.ts. Types under each label are the real schema types.
Motion: staggered section rise; springy switch thumb and segmented check; hover and press on every control.
Unbuilt, unverified: pickers open nothing on the board. Which layer each value comes from is sample data. Shell detection count is a placeholder.

note-ConfigPermissions.text:
Shows: the ordered permissions rule builder (drag handle, tool chip, pattern field, allow / ask / deny) with an add row and a Try a call checker; then the policies list.
Try: Shared Tweaks: accent (seed colour), dark, density (comfortable or compact), motion (off stills everything). items (0 to 8) changes the number of rules; 0 shows the empty state. Change an effect or edit a pattern.
Stands for: Permission.Ruleset (action, resource, effect) where the last matching rule wins (core/permission/policy.ts findLast), and ConfigPolicy actions.
Motion: rules slide on hover; effect colours animate; staggered rise.
Unbuilt, unverified: drag reordering is drawn, not working. The Try a call result is static sample output. Tool list for the picker is not defined.

note-ConfigAgents.text:
Shows: agents as cards (build, reviewer) with model, mode, temperature, step limit, colour swatches, hidden, description, system prompt and per-agent tool permissions; then the commands record.
Try: Shared Tweaks: accent (seed colour), dark, density (comfortable or compact), motion (off stills everything). items (0 to 4) changes the command rows. Drag sliders (the number field follows), pick a swatch, change a tool permission.
Stands for: ConfigAgent.Info and ConfigCommand.Info. The schema has no temperature or tools keys, so temperature is shown as request.body.temperature and tool toggles as the agent permissions ruleset.
Motion: swatch shape-morph when chosen; slider thumb squeeze; staggered card rise.
Unbuilt, unverified: whether request.body.temperature reaches every provider is not checked. The plan agent card is collapsed into a chip.

note-ConfigMcp.text:
Shows: mcp.timeout sliders; a local server (command chips, cwd, environment editor, Code Mode, protocol, pool) and a remote server (url, sign-in variant, headers) with status dots; collapsed servers; two provider cards.
Try: Shared Tweaks: accent (seed colour), dark, density (comfortable or compact), motion (off stills everything). items (0 to 5) changes the collapsed server list. Switch transport, edit key/value rows, drag timeouts.
Stands for: Mcp.LocalConfig / RemoteConfig / OAuthConfig, the Mcp status union (connected, pending, disabled, failed, needs_auth) and ConfigProvider.Info.
Motion: live ping on connected dots; springy controls; staggered rise.
Unbuilt, unverified: switching transport does not swap the form on the board. Provider key detection and model lists are sample data. No secret value is ever shown; only variable names.

note-ConfigTools.text:
Shows: lsp and formatter (All built-in / Off / Per entry, then per-language rows), tool_output sliders, watcher.ignore chips, compaction and warming.
Try: Shared Tweaks: accent (seed colour), dark, density (comfortable or compact), motion (off stills everything). Drag any slider, toggle a language server, change the warming variant.
Stands for: ConfigLSP, ConfigFormatter, ConfigToolOutput (defaults 2000 lines, 51200 bytes), ConfigWatcher, ConfigCompaction, ConfigWarming.
Motion: staggered section rise; control transitions throughout.
Unbuilt, unverified: this board stacks sections from four categories for review; in the app each sits under its own category. Built-in server and formatter names and commands are illustrative.

note-ConfigSave.text:
Shows: how edits are saved. Pending-changes bar, JSONC diff review drawer, validation error stage, and the saved stage.
Try: Shared Tweaks: accent (seed colour), dark, density (comfortable or compact), motion (off stills everything). stage: pending, review, invalid, saved.
Stands for: the config document write path (server handlers/config.ts) and the config.updated event. Only changed keys are rewritten.
Motion: bar springs up; drawer slides in; alarm pulse on the invalid card (dramatic); check pop with a burst of shapes on saved (dramatic).
Unbuilt, unverified: comment-preserving JSONC writes, per-key revert, Undo, and whether running sessions pick up changes are not confirmed.

note-ConfigBypass.text:
Shows: the bypass_permissions switch in Permissions and policies (config key, default off), with what still applies: configured deny rules and managed policies.
Try: Shared Tweaks: accent (seed colour), dark, density (comfortable or compact), motion (off stills everything). stage: off, keys, slider, confirmed, on. In keys, press Turn key 1 and Turn key 2 (each works on its own); both unlock the slider; drag it to the end for the confirmed state. Emergency exit resets it. on shows the warning banner with Turn off.
Stands for: bypass_permissions in packages/schema/src/config.ts and the ask-to-allow check in core/src/permission.ts; the settings surface is settings/configuration/configuration.tsx.
Motion: key-rotate and pop when a key turns; flowing striped fill while the slider is dragged (dramatic); burst of shapes on Confirmed (dramatic, celebratory); pulsing rings on the warning mark and alarm pulse on the banner (dramatic); drawer slide.
Unbuilt, unverified: the two-key and slider confirmation and the banner layout are this design. The slider does not snap back if released early, and Save does not write anything on the board.

note-HostSetup.text:
Shows: first run of the web app in Docker. Step rail and the current step: owner account, server settings, model provider, ready.
Try: Shared Tweaks: accent (seed colour), dark, density (comfortable or compact), motion (off stills everything). stage: owner, server, provider, done. The port slider and segmented options respond.
Stands for: hosting/ in the repository (compose.yaml, setup.ts, port 4096). Today the server uses one password from hosting/.env; owner accounts are new.
Motion: flowing progress under the active step (dramatic); check pop on done; staggered rise.
Unbuilt, unverified: accounts, the first-account-is-owner rule, and the credential store wording are proposals. No secret is displayed.

note-HostDashboard.text:
Shows: the host dashboard. LAN address with QR placeholder, health checks, version and update mode, storage, people.
Try: Shared Tweaks: accent (seed colour), dark, density (comfortable or compact), motion (off stills everything). stage: healthy, updating, degraded. items (0 to 6) changes the health list.
Stands for: the container health check in hosting/Dockerfile and the update config key.
Motion: live ping on healthy; flowing update bar (dramatic); alarm pulse on the degraded error card (dramatic); storage meter grows in.
Unbuilt, unverified: no dashboard exists yet. Storage figures, people and check names are sample data; version is a placeholder. The QR block is a placeholder pattern, not a real code.

note-ApplianceBoot.text:
Shows: the only screen the appliance image draws: boot log on the left, address and QR on the right.
Try: Shared Tweaks: accent (seed colour), dark, density (comfortable or compact), motion (off stills everything). stage: booting, ready, error. dark changes the side panel; the console stays dark on purpose.
Stands for: appliance/rootfs (OpenRC service, /etc/issue banner with Open the app and the material-opencode helper).
Motion: flowing progress on the active boot step (dramatic); address pops in when ready; alarm pulse on the no-network error; caret blink.
Unbuilt, unverified: the graphical side panel and QR are proposals; today the banner is text only. The QR block is a placeholder pattern.

note-DeployApp.text:
Shows: the deploy app. Target list (this PC with Docker, SSH host, VirtualBox, USB flash, Raspberry Pi) and the form for the chosen target.
Try: Shared Tweaks: accent (seed colour), dark, density (comfortable or compact), motion (off stills everything). stage: choose, deploying, erase-confirm, done. erase-confirm shows the super-confirmation before a card is wiped.
Stands for: hosting/host.sh and host.bat for the PC path and appliance/build.sh for images.
Motion: flowing progress on the active deploy step (dramatic); alarm pulse on the erase dialog (dramatic); check pop on done.
Unbuilt, unverified: the deploy app does not exist. Choosing a target does not swap the form on the board. Drive detection and the typed-name check are drawn only.

Stands for: the public site for this repository. The docker command comes from hosting/Dockerfile.
Motion: glow and drift shapes behind the hero (dramatic); product shot rises, saved chip pops; feature cards morph on hover.
Unbuilt, unverified: version and password are placeholders. No testimonials or numbers are shown because none exist. Download targets are not wired.
